routes.name: LADBS building records
routes.method: Search the online building records; request records not available there from the Records Section.
routes.source_quote: Email a completed Records Research Request Form to Records.LADBS@lacity.org
routes.limitation: Record-specific review needed. Construction, alteration, completion and original occupancy dates are different facts.

routes.name: San Diego Development Services, existing occupancy certificates
routes.method: Request the existing building's original certificate and include the project address. Research fees may apply.
routes.source_quote: To request a copy of a Certificate of Occupancy for an existing building, email DSDRCD@sandiego.gov.
routes.limitation: A request route, not a certificate already acquired. An alteration permit's issue or closure date does not establish original occupancy.

routes.name: NJOGIS parcels and MOD-IV
routes.method: Review the exact-address parcel evidence and confirm the relevant building with its assessor or building department.
routes.source_quote: Search all parcels in NJ by address, county, municipality, block and lot.
routes.limitation: Parcel assessment data may be stale or cover multiple buildings. An exact address match does not establish legal applicability.
